properties.description:

* Flash Flood Warning for...
South Central Elbert County in east central Colorado...

properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued August 16 at 2:35PM MDT until August 16 at 4:45PM MDT by NWS Pueblo CO
properties.description:
...FLASH FLOOD WARNING FOR THE ASPEN ACRES BURN SCAR REMAINS IN
EFFECT UNTIL 445 PM MDT THIS AFTERNOON FOR EASTERN CUSTER AND
SOUTHWESTERN PUEBLO COUNTIES...

At 235 PM MDT, Emergency management reported flash flooding over the
Aspen Acres Burn Scar. Between 1 and 1.5 inches of rain have fallen.
Flash flooding is already occurring. Excessive rainfall over the burn
scar will result in debris flow. The debris flow can consist of rock,
mud, vegetation and other loose materials.

FLASH FLOOD EMERGENCY for Middle, Squirrel Creek and North St
Charles River through Beulah. This is a PARTICULARLY DANGEROUS
SITUATION. SEEK HIGHER GROUND NOW!

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Heavy rain producing flash
flooding in and around the Aspen Acres Burn Scar.

SOURCE...Emergency management reported.

IMPACT...This is a PARTICULARLY DANGEROUS SITUATION. SEEK HIGHER
GROUND NOW! IMMEDIATE EVACUATION along waterways and flood
prone areas in and around the Aspen Acres Burn Scar.  Climb
to higher ground if flood water threatens!

Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Beulah.

This includes the following high risk locations...
Roads and residents along the Middle, Squirrel and North Creek as
well as the North St Charles River in the Beulah area.

properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued August 16 at 1:12PM MDT until August 16 at 4:15PM MDT by NWS Pueblo CO
properties.description:
FFWPUB

The National Weather Service in Pueblo has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
The Middle Aspen Acres Burn Scar in...
East Central Custer County in southeastern Colorado...
West Central Pueblo County in southeastern Colorado...

* Until 415 PM MDT.

* At 112 PM MDT, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing
heavy rain over the Middle Aspen Acres Burn Scar. Up to 0.5 inches
of rain have fallen. The expected rainfall rate is 1.5 to 2.5
inches in 1 hour. Additional rainfall amounts of 0.5 to 1 inch are
possible in the warned area. Flash flooding is ongoing or expected
to begin shortly. Excessive rainfall over the burn scar will result
in debris flow moving through the North Saint Charles, South Creek,
Squirrel Creek, Middle Creek, and North Creek Drainages. The debris
flow can consist of rock, mud, vegetation and other loose
materials.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Thunderstorms producing
flash flooding in and around the Middle Aspen Acres Burn
Scar.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of areas in and around the
Middle Aspen Acres Burn Scar.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
San Isabel, Highway 165, Beulah, Highway 78, stream crossings, and
county roads within and immediately downstream of the burn scar.

This includes the following high risk locations...
Beulah Water Intake, Northcreek Road county line to Red Mountain Camp
and Northcreek Road from Red Mountain Camp to Beulah.

properties.headline: Flash Flood Watch issued August 16 at 11:50AM MDT until August 16 at 8:00PM MDT by NWS Pueblo CO
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flash flooding and debris flows caused by excessive rainfall
continue to be possible over the Aspen Acres burn scar.

* WHERE...Aspen Acres Burn Scar

* WHEN...Until 8 PM MDT this evening.

* IMPACTS...Heavy rainfall over the Aspen Acres burn scar is expected
up to and during the period of the watch. Residents near the Aspen
Acres burn scar should prepare for potential debris flow. Be sure
to stay up to date with information from local authorities. Heavy
rainfall could trigger flash flooding of low-lying areas, street
flooding, and debris flows in and near recent wildfire burn scars.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- National Weather Service Meteorologists are forecasting
thunderstorms with heavy rainfall over the burn scar, which may
lead to flash flooding and debris flows.
- Some locations that may experience flash flooding include...
Beulah, San Isabel, and highways 165 and 78 in and around the
Aspen Acres Burn Scar.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
